description: Na₂Ca₃Al₂F₁₄ crystallizes in the cubic I2_13 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.60 Å. Ca is bonded to eight F atoms to form distorted CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent AlF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of Ca-F bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.51 Å. Al is bonded to six F atoms to form AlF₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids and edges with three equivalent CaF₈ hexagonal bipyramids. There are three shorter (1.81 Å) and three longer (1.85 Å) Al-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Ca atoms to form corner-sharing FNaCa₃ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ca and one Al atom.
